title: Implement documentation step type
description:
Create src/jiro/steps/documentation/ with:
- documentation_command.py: DocumentationCommand class
- documentation_result.py: DocumentationResult dataclass
- documentation_verify.py: DocumentationVerify class with doc change detection algorithm:
